embeds.title: ⚠️ Merge service records?
embeds.description:
The service record on Steam ID **{steam_id}** will be merged into {member}'s record.

**Steam record:** {steam_side}
**{member}'s record:** {discord_side}

• The Steam record is **deleted**; its events, attendance and LOA move to {member}'s record.
• Steam is the source of truth: rank and status become **{new_rank}** / **{new_status}** (now {old_rank} / {old_status}), even if that is lower.
• Clashing attendance and active LOA: the Steam record wins.
• Discord rank roles are **not** changed. Use `/set_rank` to fix them.

This cannot be undone. Are you sure?
